evaluation_scope: The same seven upstream tau-retail failure trajectories, one judge run per case. This is a small diagnostic comparison, not a generalization estimate.
leakage_control: Few-shot examples come from labeled Magentic-One trajectories and have no task or trajectory ID overlap with the tau-retail evaluation cases.
decision: No configuration shows a reliable across-metric improvement. Stop prompt tuning on these seven evaluation cases; build separate development and held-out evaluation sets before further judge optimization.
